meta.title: Warehouse Safety & Condition Monitoring | Hitelecom
meta.description: Monitor rack tilt, storage temperature and humidity, leaks and machine condition. Locate each event and connect fire and personnel-safety interfaces to a defined response.
meta.heroAlt: Application illustration of a high-bay warehouse with pallet racks and a clear operating aisle

hero.h1:
Warehouse monitoring.
From alert to action.
hero.lead: Monitor rack tilt, storage conditions, water leaks and equipment changes. Connect fire and personnel-safety events to the team responsible.

installation.title: Where the sensors go.
installation.lead: Match the measurement to the location: a rack upright, storage zone, leak-prone floor point, machine or personnel-help point.
installation.proofCaption: Field installation reference — rack point, device and mounting.
installation.photoNote: Retouched field photographs supplied for this project. The installation shows a monitoring point; rack safety still requires inspection and assessment.

locations.title: Rack uprights
locations.use: Link an angle change to the row and bay that needs inspection.

locations.title: Goods zones & cold rooms
locations.use: Locate storage excursions and review the affected goods.

locations.title: Floor low points & pipe joints
locations.use: Find the wet zone and investigate the water source.

locations.title: Motors, pumps & conveyors
locations.use: Direct maintenance to the machine and operating condition.

locations.title: Crossings, docks & help points
locations.use: Connect an identified event to the designated EHS or operations team.

installation.sourceNote: Hitelecom sensors measure the selected conditions. Fire, dock, proximity and personnel-help events use compatible interfaces to their dedicated systems.

events.eyebrow: FROM AN EVENT TO THE NEXT ACTION
events.title: What happens after an alert.
events.lead: Each example links an event to its location and the person responsible for checking it.

rows.action: The rack lead follows the site procedure, checks the affected area and records the inspection decision.

rows.event: Storage temperature moves outside the agreed range
rows.action: Quality or warehouse operations reviews the duration, affected stock and refrigeration or door conditions.
Facilities checks the source, arranges drainage and coordinates protection of stock and access routes.

rows.event: Machine condition or running state changes
rows.location: Identified motor, conveyor, pump or fan
rows.action: Maintenance compares the operating context and inspects the machine before deciding the next work.

rows.event: A personnel-help or safety-system event is reported
rows.location: Named dock, crossing or work zone
rows.action: The designated operations or EHS team follows the local response route. Dedicated local warnings and protective functions retain their duties.

events.note: Illustrative response paths. Define the thresholds, receiving roles and local protective duties for your installation.

connection.eyebrow: HOW THE INFORMATION REACHES THE TEAM
connection.title: How the system connects.
connection.lead: Readings and events reach the platform through the configured network. The receiving team uses the location and history to respond.

steps.title: Measure at the point
steps.text: A selected sensor or agreed system interface supplies the reading or event.

steps.title: See the location and history
steps.text: Use Hitelecom Cloud or your platform to review point identity, reported condition, time and configured alerts.

steps.title: Record the response
steps.text: Agree the receiving role and how inspection, stock decisions or corrective actions are retained.

connection.note: Cellular terminals and compatible LoRa gateway routes are configured for the site. H100 is a separate local USB/PC recorder.
